market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields are actually falling in sympathy and whether any macro headline (jobs, credit event) is driving both the market and bonds.
time_plan.1h: Confirm move is not just thin Polymarket liquidity; cross-check fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) implied cuts for corroboration.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether equities and credit spreads confirm a risk-off/recession narrative consistent with deep easing.
time_plan.6h: Review whether the probability shift persists or mean-reverts; look for Fed speak or data that could anchor expectations.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net TLT move vs expectation; flag as non-tradable if below threshold and log calibration.

predictions.reasoning: Ten 25bp cuts (250bps of easing) in 2026 is a deep-recession/emergency-easing tail scenario. A sharp rise in this market's implied probability would signal rapidly deteriorating growth/credit expectations and aggressive forward Fed easing, which pulls the front end and belly of the curve lower and bids duration. TLT is a liquid, rate-sensitive proxy that rallies when the market prices much deeper cuts. The mapping direction is reasonable but the 12h magnitude is far below the 700bps tradable threshold; duration rarely moves 7% in half a day absent a crisis print.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY direction and real yields (TIPS) to see if the dovish-easing channel is active.
time_plan.1h: Verify gold move is coincident with the rate-cut repricing and not a separate geopolitical shock.
time_plan.2h: Compare gold vs silver and miners for confirmation of a genuine rates-driven move.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether dollar weakness is sustaining the gold bid.
time_plan.12h: Measure net GLD move vs expectation; mark non-tradable and record outcome for calibration.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in the probability of extreme Fed easing implies lower real rates and a weaker dollar, both supportive of gold. Gold is a liquid proxy for a dovish/real-rate-decline regime. However, the link is indirect and gold also responds to the geopolitical/risk backdrop; 12h magnitude is well under the 700bps threshold and direction can be swamped by dollar and flight-to-quality cross-currents.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026; 10 cuts equals 250bps of easing
Such a scenario is only realistic in a severe recession or emergency-easing cycle
Standard macro transmission: deeper expected cuts lower yields, weaken USD, support duration and gold
700bps tradable threshold over a 12h window is very large for these proxies
uncertainty_notes: We do not know the direction or size of any actual probability move; this is a forward mapping
Polymarket pricing on extreme tails is thin and noisy, prone to false signals
12h horizon is too short for most macro proxies to register the implied magnitude

llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether the Fed delivers ten 25bp cuts (250bps of easing) in 2026 — a deep-recession/emergency tail. If its implied probability rose sharply, the cleanest public-market reads are a rally in long-duration Treasuries (TLT) and a bid in gold (GLD) via lower real rates and a softer dollar. Both mappings are directionally sensible but modest over 12h and well below the 700bps tradable bar, so this is best treated as non-tradable, low-confidence research.
key_assumptions: A rise in implied probability reflects genuine recession/easing expectations rather than noise
No offsetting shock (e.g., inflation surprise, geopolitical risk-on) dominates the tape
failure_modes: The probability move is already public/priced via fed funds futures, so no residual edge
Thin Polymarket liquidity creates a false signal with no corroboration in bonds
Proxies are weakly exposed over 12h and dominated by dollar, equity, or geopolitical flows
Direction reverses if the easing narrative is paired with inflation fears that lift yields instead
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
